This application coming on for hearing this day, the court passed the following:
 ORDER 1.

This is first application u/s. 439 of the Cr.P.C. filed by the applicant who is in custody since 21.6.2023 in connection with Crime No.52/2019, registered at Police Station Vijay Nagar, District Indore for the offences punishable u/s. 302, 307, 120-B/34 of the IPC and u/s. 25 & 27 of the Arms Act.

2. As per prosecution story, on 16.1.2019 some unidentified person - : 2 :-

1 killed Sandeep Agrawal @ Sandeep Tel in an open street.

sentences.text: After investigation by the police it has been revealed that said Sandeep Agrawal was killed for a dispute of Rs.17.00 Crores with Rohit Sethi by way of contract killing.
3. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the present applicant has been implicated in this case only on the basis of memorandum u/s. 27 of the Evidence Act.
Apart from the memorandum u/s. 27 there of no evidence against the petitioner to connect him with the crime.
Since, he has been a habitual criminal, therefore, he has been implicated by the police.
There is no ballistic report to establish that the applicant fired the gun-shot and killed Sandeep Tel.
The main accused Rohit has been granted bail by the apex Court and other accused have also been granted bail either by the trial Court or the High Court.
Under these circumstances, counsel prays for grant of bail to the applicant.
4. Learned Govt. Advocate for the respondent/State opposes the bail application by submitting that there is enough evidence against the present applicant.
There are as many as 26 criminal cases registered against him.
He is a known criminal of Rajasthan.
If he is released on bail, he will commit the offence again.
Other accused persons also named him in their statements.
The applicant has also not disclosed as to out of 26 criminal cases, in how many cases he has been granted bail by the competent court as all the criminal trials are pending against him.
prays for rejection of the application 5.
